messages:
jason: noticing a big latency spike in na-west runtime since ~2143651200. 95p token latency jumped from ~45ms -> ~210ms. KV cache miss rate up, continuous-batcher queue depth climbing. anyone oncall?
infra-bot: [ALERT] na-west.kv_cache.miss_rate > 10% (3m); hotpool utilization=92%; batcher_controller restarts detected.
jason: tagging @maria and @li — please triage.
maria: on it. looking at provisioner and batcher logs now. I see repeated OOMs in batcher-controller around 2143651180 and affinity changes applied at ~2143651100.
li: that matches the morning runtime tweak (batching-affinity, rev a1b2c3). could be increasing head-of-line wait.
samir: provisioning note — NA_WEST GPU quota bump is slow today; new allocs will be ~18–22m. spots possible but with interruption risk.
jason: short term mitigation: can we disable continuous batching for na-west hotpool and shift some traffic to na-east/eu-west?
maria: ok applying flag: `POST https://config.redwood/api/flags` payload: ```{"pool":"na-west-hot","disable_continuous_batching":true}``` applying now.
deploy-bot: config change applied by maria at 2143651252 (change-id: cfg-7789).
jason: starting traffic shift: `bin/traffic-shift --from na-west --to na-east,eu-west --percent 30 --reason "latency spike"`
infra-bot: traffic-shift job started (id ts=2143651248) — routing changes will roll out over ~2 mins.
maria: disabling continuous batching immediately dropped 95p from ~210ms -> ~115ms. queue depth decreasing. good sign.
li: kv-cache miss rate still elevated though. I'm going to purge prefix cache for the hottest models to restore hit-rate.
maria: running purge: `./admin/purge_prefix_cache --models "gptx-7b-hot" --pool na-west` — kicked off.
infra-bot: prefix cache purge complete at 2143651286. kv_cache.miss_rate trending down to baseline.
samir: provisioning update — attempted spot launch; 6/10 nodes came up, 4 preempted during init. not reliable. recommend keep traffic-shift strategy for now.
jason: cost tradeoff: Samir, estimate of switching 30% to eu + na-east impact?
samir: rough estimate +$2.5k/day while split (inter-region egress + extra warm capacity). Approve for incident window?
jason: approve. availability first. :thumbsup:
li: opening incident ticket IN-2143 with timeline, metrics, commit refs (rev a1b2c3), and mitigation steps. assigning postmortem to eng-infra + eng-runtime.
maria: next steps: 1) rollback batching-affinity tweak if CI repros, 2) add a config safety check to prevent affinity that increases queue depth without canary, 3) adjust autoscaler to prefer warm standby nodes in NA_WEST.
deploy-bot: rollback job queued (rollback-id rb-334) — will only run if ops approves.
jason: agree on steps. please add the cost impact to the ticket and include runbooks for manual cache purge and disable-batching.
li: noted. I've also added a short-term monitor to alert at 2x baseline queue depth (so we catch this earlier).
maria: incident currently mitigated: latency down to ~60ms 95p in na-west after combined actions. keeping thread open for one more hour to monitor.
samir: adding a cost/ops note — we should consider reserved warm pool in NA_WEST for high SLAs, cheaper than repeated cross-region shifts.
jason: good action item for postmortem. thanks all.
li: closing the immediate alert chain, leaving incident ticket open for RCA and autoscale config changes.
maria: created follow-up PRs for: autoscaler warm pool policy, batching-affinity revert test, and flagging for safe rollout. PR links posted in IN-2143.
jason: great work. marker: incident mitigated at 2143651498. we'll reconvene in the postmortem. :white_check_mark:
